description: Add a composition to the Render Queue (Composition > Add to Render Queue) with a render settings template, an output module template and an output file, optionally a time span, a single frame (Composition > Save Frame As > File) or as a pre-render that imports the result and replaces the composition's uses (Composition > Pre-render)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

frame.description: Render only the frame at this time (seconds), as Save Frame As > File does; not with start or duration

outputFile.description: Absolute output path; the extension should match the output module

outputModule.description: Output module template, e.g. "High Quality", "H.264 - Match Render Settings - 15 Mbps"

preRender.description: Pre-render: after rendering, import the file and replace the composition's uses with it. Default false

name: queue_render
title: Queue Render
